key_insight: Hidden-cohort fairness training optimizes model performance by addressing latent subpopulations in medical imaging, rather than relying solely on visible demographic attributes.
clinical_relevance: This approach enhances safety and fairness in medical image analysis, potentially reducing disparities in diagnosis across diverse patient groups.
method: Introduces label-free hidden-cohort fairness (LHCF) training paradigm.
Clusters images into K appearance-based cohorts for fairness optimization.
Reduces model error and enhances fairness without requiring demographic labels.
evidence_signal: LHCF achieves state-of-the-art fairness results on single and multiple demographic attributes using a proposed benchmark, HIDFairBench.
watch_item: Scaling the method may require careful consideration to ensure the robustness of clustering across different imaging conditions.
paper_title: Fairness Beyond Demographics: Optimizing Performance Across Appearance-Based Hidden Cohorts in Medical Imaging
